geometry.stand_height: extra-tall band drawn to house two buttons: visible front height about 3 button-diameters (~4.5 cm), clearly taller than the standard 1-button stand of sibling cs-square
geometry.neckline_seam: shallow downward curve where the stand joins the shirt body/placket top (red curved line in blueprint)
geometry.placket_below: standard sewn button placket descending from the stand with TWO parallel vertical topstitch rows and its first placket button visible below the stand (drawn black in blueprint)
